# allinkl_cronjobs (Data Source)

Reads all cronjobs of the KAS account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "allinkl_cronjobs" "all" {}

output "inactive_cronjobs" {
  value = [for j in data.allinkl_cronjobs.all.cronjobs : j.comment if !j.active]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `cronjobs` (Attributes List) Every cronjob of the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cronjobs))

<a id="nestedatt--cronjobs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cronjobs`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the job runs.
- `comment` (String) Free text describing the job.
- `day_of_month` (String) Day-of-month field of the schedule.
- `day_of_week` (String) Day-of-week field of the schedule.
- `hour` (String) Hour field of the schedule.
- `http_user` (String) HTTP basic auth user.
- `id` (String) KAS-assigned id.
- `mail_address` (String) Address that receives the output of each run.
- `minute` (String) Minute field of the schedule.
- `month` (String) Month field of the schedule.
- `protocol` (String) `http` or `https`.
- `url` (String) Address the job requests, without the protocol.
